paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: Impact of batch size on decoding speed. Evaluated on LLaDA with a single NVIDIA H20; prefill length fixed at 100 tokens.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between batch size and decoding speed, measured in tokens per second, for different sequence lengths (L = 16, 32, 64, 128) using two methods: dKV-Cache and Origin. The x-axis represents batch size, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 120, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis represents tokens per second, also with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 225, and tick labels at intervals of 25. There are eight lines in the plot, each corresponding to a different sequence length and method combination, distinguished by color (blue, red, gray, black) and line style (solid for dKV-Cache, dashed for Origin). For dKV-Cache, the lines for L = 16, 32, 64, 128 are solid and colored gray, blue, red, and black, respectively, and they increase as batch size increases, with values at batch size 1 and 128 being (15.21, 202.31) for L = 16, (34.53, 183.28) for L = 32, (67.19, 130.58) for L = 64, and (118.55, 81.16) for L = 128. For Origin, the lines are dashed and follow a similar color scheme, with values at batch size 1 and 128 being (15.24, 59.71) for L = 16, (34.53, 48.93) for L = 32, (58.61, 35.2) for L = 64, and (75.72, 35.2) for L = 128. All lines show an upward trend as batch size increases, with varying rates of increase.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the impact of batch size on decoding speed, comparing 'dKV-Cache-Decode' and 'Origin' across different values of L. The x-axis represents 'Batch Size', with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 120, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis represents 'Tokens/s', also with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 225, and tick labels at intervals of 25. There are eight lines in the plot, representing 'dKV-Cache-Decode' and 'Origin' for L = 16, 32, 64, and 128. For L = 16, 'dKV-Cache-Decode' starts at approximately 75 Tokens/s at a batch size of 8, increases to around 183 Tokens/s at a batch size of 128, with a solid gray line and triangle markers, while 'Origin' starts at about 34 Tokens/s and reaches 35 Tokens/s, with a dashed gray line and triangle markers. For L = 32, 'dKV-Cache-Decode' begins at roughly 67 Tokens/s, rises to about 130 Tokens/s, with a solid red line and circle markers, whereas 'Origin' goes from 34 Tokens/s to 48 Tokens/s, with a dashed red line and circle markers. For L = 64, 'dKV-Cache-Decode' starts at approximately 118 Tokens/s, climbs to around 173 Tokens/s, with a solid blue line and square markers, and 'Origin' goes from 59 Tokens/s to 69 Tokens/s, with a dashed blue line and square markers. For L = 128, 'dKV-Cache-Decode' begins at about 158 Tokens/s, increases to roughly 202 Tokens/s, with a solid black line and diamond markers, while 'Origin' starts at 78 Tokens/s and reaches 81 Tokens/s, with a dashed black line and diamond markers. All 'dKV-Cache-Decode' lines show an upward trend as batch size increases, whereas 'Origin' lines remain relatively steady.
